Dear Catalyst Review Team,
We are submitting the Milestone 1 Proof of Achievement for Project Catalyst 1300092.
The first Embrace MiCA webinar was held as a publicly accessible online session, published on Sparring's YouTube channel on 19 June 2025, and promoted through Sparring's public social channels. Feedback was collected following the session through a dedicated Google Form. The supporting evidence is listed below.
Deliverable 1: Webinar Held
The first Embrace MiCA webinar was delivered as a publicly accessible online session and is available on demand on Sparring's YouTube channel.
・Session video (public, full length): https://youtu.be/CFeNZ6Z909E
・Title: Embracing MiCA by Sparring: EU's New Crypto Regulation | Powered by Project Catalyst | PART 1
・Published: 19 June 2025
・Duration: 48 minutes 44 seconds
・Live attendance: 17
・Recording views: 101 as of 26 August 2026
・Speaker: Tomas Richter Urban, attorney-at-law and Head of the Crypto & Web3 Desk at Sparring
・Access: Publicly streamable without login or registration

Topics covered
・Scope & Applicability
・Crypto-Asset Classification
・Licensing & Compliance Requirements
・Stablecoin Regulation & Reserve Requirements
・Market Abuse & Consumer Protection

The session included a live Q&A at the end of the webinar, during which attendees could submit questions directly to the speaker. The Q&A begins at 41:04 in the recording.
